# A SMARTER ME!

Canonical play URL: https://kids-crown-of-greatness.vercel.app/
Repository: https://github.com/Joenasriani/kids-a-smarter-me

A SMARTER ME! is a five-scenario prosocial, routine and safety choice game developed as part of a multi-game interactive children’s edutainment activation in the UAE.

Each run randomly samples five scenarios from a 20-scenario bank. Each scenario presents two choices in randomized screen positions. The source marks one choice as preferred; non-preferred choices add scenario-specific advice to the result screen. A perfect run receives one random positive role label.

The implementation is not a validated measure of intelligence, personality, morality, social development or psychological traits.
